title: E5 shared-map acquisition innovation, rank-acquisition information budget, non-submodularity and policies, and gauge/symmetry controls

settings.theory: Theorem 9 shared-map innovation and compensation, Corollary 10 rank-acquisition budget, pose-Schur logdet non-submodularity, greedy/pair/exhaustive/random policies
settings.matrices_note: Each frame is current-cleaned before use (a_l,b_l); only full-column-rank map models use the Theorem 9 inverse formula, otherwise the singular fallback/variational stack is used.
settings.policy_objective: g(S)=logdet(J_{old union S}+Lambda_x I_p); the fixed old model is included so each one-row candidate is an exact Theorem-9 Schur update and all scoring is shared-map (no forward/adjoint).

singular_fallback.note: G is singular; the naive formula replaces G^{-1} by pinv(G) and produces the reported wrong value.

compensation_criterion.criterion_note: Stacked pose visible iff [T2-T1; T3-T1] is full column rank when each a_l is injective and each frame hides every pose direction.

saturated_new_frame.note: frame-specific nuisance spanning every data row makes the cleaned tangent zero; adding it changes no information.

nonsubmodularity.note: g(S)=logdet(J_S+Lambda_x I_p) on the shared-map stack; g1+g2 < g({1,2})+g(empty) violates submodularity.

acquisition_policies.objective_note: g(S)=logdet(J_{old union S}+Lambda_x I_p); the fixed old model is included so each one-row candidate is an exact Theorem-9 Schur update and all scoring is shared-map (no forward/adjoint).

neutral_logdet.distinction_note: Lambda_x=0 logdet is finite only for full-rank J (J over the fixed old model plus three candidates is full rank in all 56 subsets); for singular candidate-only stacks a positive Lambda_x is required to avoid logdet(0)=-inf.

global_gauge_null.note: Each row a=[1], b=[1] keeps the joint tangent null vector (delta_chi, delta_x) proportional to (1,-1); relative frames cannot anchor the absolute pose.

anchor_restores_absolute.note: Anchor row (a_new=[0], b_new=[1]) measures the absolute pose direction, breaking the global rigid gauge.

source_stabilizer_note.reason: True isotropic-vs-directional source-stabilizer behavior requires the physical full-wave core (secondary-stage tangent runner), which is not available in this synthetic tangent-matrix validation package.
